messages:
olivia: deploy-bot posted: promotion of chart payments v2.15.0 to prod started; canary 10% paused after spike in 5xx on /checkout

deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: canary_metric(errors_5xx) > threshold(3%) for 120s. service=payments, chart=payments v2.15.0, values override detected: payments.redis.pool=5. Suggested: rollback to v2.14.3 or revert value and hotfix.

jax: seen. which endpoint? frontend-prod shows spike for /checkout and /pay callbacks.

maria: agree revert unless we can patch quickly. change window open until 23:00 UTC.

sre_oncall: logs point at redis connection churn right after pod startup. connections dropped when pool==5.

anya: looks like PR #482 changed redis.pool to 5 in values.yaml override. cc @release-manager-kyle

release-manager-kyle: can we hotfix by setting pool back to 20? fallback option is rolling back chart version. Hotfix command: `helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace prod --set payments.redis.pool=20 --timeout 5m --wait`

jax: hotfix sounds faster. do it under the auto-pause and verify canary before resuming promotion. if rollout degrades we rollback immediately.

maria: I'll update release notes and ping CS. short note: "reverted redis.pool override after checkout errors; monitoring extended"

deploy-bot: Approval required from release-manager-kyle to perform hotfix in prod during change window.

release-manager-kyle: approve hotfix. maria push notes; olivia run the helm command and hold for rollback window.

olivia: running: `helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace prod --set payments.redis.pool=20 --timeout 5m --wait`

olivia: rollout progressing 40% -> 100%. /checkout 5xx back to baseline :thumbsup:

anya: confirming traffic metrics — payments 5xx down. good to resume.

deploy-bot: RESUME: canary resumed. promotion to v2.15.0 remains paused until values revert PR is merged. Action items: [1] PR to revert payments.redis.pool -> 20 (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/payments/pull/489), [2] release notes updated, [3] extend change window to 23:30 UTC.

maria: release notes updated and posted to #release-notes doc. short link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-payments

jax: marking thread resolved for now. will watch infra alerts for the next hour. no rollback performed.
